_note: Verified 2026-08-23. METAL MORPH LTD (16235318), incorporated 2025-02-06 and registered at a residential address in London SW2, which is the founder's address rather than an office. Moletsane Mophethe is the sole director and sole person with significant control, matching the single founder named in the press. The register holds no capital filings, so the round is press-corroborated only. The six UK water-utility partnerships, the Thames Water and Anglian Water names, and the nine-person team figure are press-reported and were not independently verified. UKTN reports GBP700k of pre-seed equity plus a separate GBP100k Ofwat grant and a further GBP450k available on milestones; only the GBP700k is recorded as the round. Public facts only; no contact data.
one_liner: Metal Morph recovers the aluminium and iron-based treatment chemicals that water and wastewater plants would otherwise discharge, and puts them back into the treatment process on site, so a plant buys less new chemical and sends less waste away.
headcount_source: Scout reporting described a nine-person team in August 2026, consistent with a company incorporated in February 2025 with one director on the register. Press-reported, not independently verified.

founders.name: Moletsane Mophethe
founders.background: The sole director and sole person with significant control of METAL MORPH LTD since its incorporation in February 2025.
